title: Affine module models with supported cohomology
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], f a global scalar [def-sc-derived-global-scalar], E and Eprime quasi-coherent derived objects [def-pc-derived-category], and E perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Assume each cohomology stalk of Eprime outside V(f) is zero. For an affine open U and integer k, put A=Gamma(U,O_X) and let R be derived localized-site restriction [lem-sc-derived-hom-mayer-vietoris]. There exist a bounded complex P of finite projective A-modules, M in D(A), and a full additive functor F from D(A) to the localized-site derived category over U, together with eP:F(Q(P)) isomorphic to R(E) and eM:F(M) isomorphic to R(Eprime[k]). Every element of every H^i(M) is killed by a power of f|U. For every global scalar a, F(a|U times id_Q(P)) composed with eP.hom equals eP.hom composed with R(schemeDerivedScalar X a id_E). This asserts only models and scalar comparison, not torsion of derived Hom.

source.place: Tag 08EJ, affine paragraph (canonical text checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08EJ)

proof.text: Construct F as mapDerivedCategory of the explicit affinePerfectSheafification. Prove tilde preserves monomorphisms by localization injectivity, then use its additive left adjoint structure to prove exactness; restriction and the over-site equivalence are exact. F is additive. Compose the affine derived equivalence and affine localized-site transport, including the full quasi-coherent inclusion, to obtain a full functor G. Their comparisons identify Q followed by G with Q of sheafification. Descend this comparison through localization to G isomorphic to F, and transfer fullness along it.

Apply affine_open_perfect_source_model to F and mapDerivedCategoryFactors, obtaining P, its bounds, finite projective terms and eP. Independently apply affine_open_supported_target_model to the same F and comparison, obtaining M, elementwise torsion and eM. Neither lemma contains the other part of the conclusion.

Package P, M, F, the proved Full and Additive instances, and the model witnesses. Apply affine_open_realization_scalar to the specific P and eP for each a. This gives the remaining displayed scalar equality.

theorem perfect_support_affine_module_model
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (f : RingCat.sectionsSubring (X.sheaf.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat.{u}))
    (E E' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (hE : X.IsPerfect E.obj)
    (hSupport : ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ X.zeroLocus (U := ⊤) {f.val (op ⊤)} →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E'.obj).val.presheaf x)))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (k : ℤ) :
    let A := ↑(X.sheaf.obj.obj (op U))
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
    let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
      (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))),
      F.Full ∧ F.Additive ∧
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero (P.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective A (P.X i)) ∧
      (∀ (i : ℤ) (m : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj M),
        ∃ n : ℕ, (f.val (op U)) ^ n • m = 0) ∧
      ∃ (eP : F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ R.obj E.obj)
        (eM : F.obj M ≅ R.obj (E'.obj⟦k⟧)),
        ∀ a : RingCat.sectionsSubring (X.sheaf.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat.{u}),
          F.map ((show A from a.val (op U)) • 𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫ eP.hom =
            eP.hom ≫ R.map (schemeDerivedScalar X a (𝟙 E.obj))
